Front-End Developer (React)
Harbourside Software – Bristol, on-site
£45-55k depending on experience

Harbourside makes booking software for marinas and harbours. Small team, big customers.

Must have
- Minimum of 2 years' experience building production React applications
- TypeScript, HTML and CSS
- Familiarity with REST APIs
- Git

Preferred
- Next.js
- Tailwind
- Jest or Vitest

This role is based in our Bristol office five days a week.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.
